text:
Aria: hit a reproducible stall in staging where prefetch workers and eviction sweeps form a circular wait under tight demote cadence. stack gist: ```prefetch: lock(shard)
evict: lock(tenant)
... both waiting on each other```
Dev: can you paste the minimal repro or gist?
Aria: gist: https://gist.github.com/repro-6155551212 (small load script + trace)
Naveen: looks like lock-order inversion. three short options: 1) flip prefetch to tenant->shard, 2) RPC handoff (eviction asks prefetch to yield), 3) shared-read tenant lock for prefetch + exclusive for eviction.
Tao: flipping ordering is simple correctness-wise but expands prefetch critical section and may regress 99.9th. need bench.
Rina: RPC handoff (Steal/Transfer) avoids global lock surgery but adds RPC failure surface and need for idempotent apply. also transient duplicate-ownership risk.
Dev: prototype idea: eviction issues non-blocking TransferPrefix(req_id, tenant, prefix). if no ACK within X ms eviction requeues and backoffs. use holder_epoch to fence applies.
Aria: short-term mitigation: bounded acquire in eviction (timeout + requeue) to avoid full-system stall. pair with lower eviction budget to prevent OOM.
Naveen: telemetry: sample "wait_chain" when goroutine blocks >5ms (list held locks). emit handoff_event metric for transfer RPCs.
Tao: I'll bench three variants (flip vs RPC vs RW-lock) on hotset (10k keys, zipf=.9) with prefetch conc 1/4/8 and demote 2/10/30s. measure 95/99/99.9 and stall_count.
Rina: sketch proto: ```rpc TransferPrefix(TransferReq) returns (TransferReply); message TransferReq{string tenant; string prefix; string req_id;} message TransferReply{enum Status{OK=0; BUSY=1; NOT_FOUND=2;} Status status; uint64 holder_epoch;}``` // handoff must be idempotent
Dev: tests to add: prefetch crash mid-handoff, duplicate transfer, partial apply. reconciler should scan dual-owners and resolve by epoch.
Aria: owners: Tao benches, Rina proto + failure doc, Naveen telemetry, Dev bounded-acquire patch. reconvene with numbers.
handoff-bot: created INF-2710: "staging: prefetch-evict circular-wait investigation"
Dev: will stage bounded-acquire canary today. keep thread small and paste PRs/CSVs.
